title: Peumus boldus tea for medicinal use
intro: Peumus boldus tea is a traditional herbal preparation made from the leaves of the Peumus boldus plant, commonly known as boldo. It has been used for centuries in South American herbalism, particularly in Chile, for its purported medicinal properties. The tea is often consumed to support digestive health and may help alleviate symptoms of indigestion and bloating. It is also believed to have mild antiseptic and anti-inflammatory effects. However, it should be used with caution and under the guidance of a qualified herbalist or healthcare provider.
